new='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The repeated color pattern is followed by a matching line that indicates
    # how far the incomplete rows should continue.
    cells = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,)]
    color = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if color in grid[r]]
    # Pattern occurs in two separated blocks; extend rows in the later block
    # to the rightmost extent of the corresponding earlier pattern rows.
    cut = next((i for i in range(1,len(rows)) if rows[i] - rows[i-1] > 1), None)
    if cut is None: return out
    upper, lower = rows[:cut], rows[cut:]
    offset = lower[0] - upper[0]
    for r in lower:
        src = r - offset
        if 0 <= src < h:
            end = max((c for c,v in enumerate(grid[src]) if v == color), default=-1)
            own = max((c for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v == color), default=-1)
            for c in range(own+1, end+1):
                if out[r][c] == 0: out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
